about.description:
I am originally from southern Bahia, Brazil, and my connection with technology began in childhood, when mobile games and visits to internet cafés sparked my curiosity about computers and the digital world. Over time, that curiosity grew into a desire to understand how things work beyond the screen. 

This interest led me to pursue a technical degree in IT, where I began exploring programming and discovered my passion for software development. Since then, I have continued to build my path in the field, striving to turn ideas into applications and understand the challenges involved in creating solutions.

termo-clone.description: A complete clone of Termo, the Brazilian Wordle.
termo-clone.title: Termo Clone
termo-clone.about:
Termo became a hugely popular game with a strong daily routine around it. It was common to open the game and share the result with a group of friends, comparing who solved it in fewer guesses that day.

That familiarity with the game is what sparked the desire to build the logic behind it, word validation, the letter-by-letter feedback calculation, and the Duet and Quartet modes, where several boards are solved at the same time using the same keyboard. A way to turn that daily habit into a complete technical project.
termo-clone.functions:
Features three game modes: Solo, Duet, and Quartet. In multiplayer-board modes, players must discover two or four words simultaneously using the same guesses and virtual keyboard. Each attempt is evaluated independently across all boards, with a letter-by-letter feedback system that also accounts for repeated letters in the target words.

The experience also includes an interactive interface with light and dark themes, Portuguese and English language switching, and sound controls. Players can access a visual guide explaining the rules and demonstrating each type of letter feedback at any point during the game. Once a game ends, a results screen reveals the target words and displays the outcome for each board, allowing players to achieve different results within the same round.

ticksy.description: Help desk system to create, assign and track support tickets, with metrics dashboard and notifications.
ticksy.title: Ticksy
ticksy.about: Ticksy started as a personal project driven by my interest in building a realistic support management system. I wanted to go beyond basic CRUD operations and explore how a full-stack application works in practice, bringing together ticket management, role-based access control, notifications and structured workflows.
ticksy.functions:
Manages the entire support ticket lifecycle, from submission to assignment and resolution. The system provides role-specific experiences: employees can submit requests and track their progress, technical assistance teams handle their assigned tickets, and administrators manage users, distribute tickets, and monitor operational metrics. Ticket listings include pagination and actions tailored to each user's permissions.

The dashboard provides ticket status indicators and recent activity, with additional charts that allow administrators to monitor ticket distribution. To keep everyone informed, the system delivers individual real-time notifications about new tickets, assignments, and status changes, with per-user read tracking. The application also allows users to edit their profile information and personalize their experience by switching between light and dark themes and Portuguese and English.
